title: Colts announce Jonathan Taylor’s extension as backfield duo stays ‘on fire’ in lone night practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts announce Jonathan Taylor’s extension as backfield duo stays ‘on fire’ in lone night practice
sources.description: The festivities began with Colts principal owner Carly Irsay-Gordon declaring that running back Jonathan Taylor is “here to stay” after the 27-year-old tailback agreed to a two-year, $44 million contract extension.
